tags.name: Chaotic

tags.name: Contrast
tags.question: Which of these are Contrast: hard darks against bright lights?

tags.name: Metallic
tags.question: Which of these are Metallic: shiny, chrome or polished-metal surfaces?
tags.rubric: Metallic: surfaces look like chrome, polished metal or liquid mercury, with sharp specular highlights, reflections or embossed sheen. 1 = clearly metallic throughout; 0.5 = metallic in places or briefly; 0 = no metallic look (flat colour, glow, soft gradients).

tags.name: Liquid
tags.question: Which of these are Liquid: flowing, fluid motion?
tags.rubric: Liquid: the picture flows like a fluid: smooth swirling, smearing, rippling or melting motion, like ink in water or paint being stirred. Judge across the frames. 1 = clearly fluid throughout; 0.5 = partly or weakly fluid; 0 = rigid, geometric or static motion.

tags.name: Glow
tags.question: Which of these Glow: soft light bleeding from bright shapes?
tags.rubric: Glow: bright shapes give off soft light that bleeds into the dark around them, like neon, embers or light trails. 1 = glowing light is the main look; 0.5 = some glow; 0 = hard-edged or flat, no light bleeding.

tags.name: Grainy
tags.question: Which of these are Grainy: noisy, speckled or sandy texture?
tags.rubric: Grainy: the picture has a fine noisy texture: speckle, static, sand, film grain or dithering. 1 = grain covers most of the picture; 0.5 = grain in parts; 0 = smooth surfaces and clean gradients.

tags.name: Waveform
tags.question: Which of these show a Waveform: a visible audio line or oscilloscope trace?
tags.rubric: Waveform: a visible audio waveform is a clear element: a line, ring or oscilloscope trace that wiggles like sound, drawn over or within the picture. 1 = an obvious waveform; 0.5 = faint or only in some frames; 0 = none visible.

tags.name: Unique
tags.question: Which of these are Unique: unlike anything else you've seen in the pack?

tags.name: WTF
tags.question: Which of these are WTF: bizarre, surprising, makes you look twice?
tags.rubric: WTF: the picture is bizarre or surprising for a music visualizer: strange recognisable imagery, glitches that look intentional, unsettling or absurd forms, or a style unlike typical MilkDrop presets (swirls, tunnels, waveforms). 1 = genuinely weird; 0.5 = somewhat odd; 0 = a typical, expected visualizer look.

tags.name: Symmetric
tags.question: Which of these are Symmetric: mirror-symmetric left to right or top to bottom?

tags.name: Kaleidoscope
tags.question: Which of these are Kaleidoscope: repeated mirrored wedges around a centre?
tags.rubric: Kaleidoscope: the picture repeats as mirrored wedges or segments around a centre point, like a kaleidoscope or mandala. 1 = clear repeated radial mirroring; 0.5 = partial or loose radial repetition; 0 = no radial repetition (simple left-right mirror doesn't count).

tags.name: Tunnel
tags.question: Which of these are Tunnel: flying into or out of a tunnel or vortex?
tags.rubric: Tunnel: the picture reads as moving through a tunnel, tube or vortex: concentric rings or walls rushing towards or away from a vanishing point. 1 = a clear tunnel; 0.5 = a hint of depth towards a centre; 0 = flat, no sense of travelling into depth.

tags.name: Spiral
tags.question: Which of these are Spiral: spiral arms or a spinning twist?
tags.rubric: Spiral: spiral arms, a twisting vortex or a swirl winding around a centre are a main element. 1 = an obvious spiral; 0.5 = some twisting around a centre; 0 = no spiral form.

tags.name: Geometric
tags.question: Which of these are Geometric: hard-edged shapes, lines, grids or polygons?
tags.rubric: Geometric: the picture is built from clean mathematical shapes: straight lines, polygons, circles, grids, regular patterns with hard edges. 1 = clearly geometric; 0.5 = geometric elements mixed with soft or organic ones; 0 = soft, organic or formless.

tags.name: Organic
tags.question: Which of these are Organic: forms that look grown or alive, like cells, plants, smoke or flesh?
tags.rubric: Organic: forms look natural or alive: cells, tendrils, petals, coral, smoke, clouds, skin or tissue, with irregular curved edges. 1 = clearly organic; 0.5 = partly natural-looking; 0 = mechanical, geometric or abstract noise.

tags.name: Fractal
tags.question: Which of these are Fractal: self-similar detail repeating at smaller and smaller scales?
tags.rubric: Fractal: the picture shows self-similar structure, the same shape repeating at smaller and smaller scales (Mandelbrot or Julia sets, recursive feedback zooms, branching that repeats). 1 = clearly fractal; 0.5 = some recursive repetition; 0 = no self-similarity across scales.
